rows.title: The planar dual conjecture for Laplacian quadratic forms
rows.statement:
Let $G_1$ and $G_2$ be connected planar graphs. Suppose they have embeddings into the $2$-sphere such that the dual graphs with respect to these embeddings are isomorphic as multigraphs.

**Planar dual conjecture.** The quadratic forms over $\mathbb{Z}$ represented by the combinatorial Laplacians of $G_1$ and $G_2$ are equivalent.

This conjecture proposes that, for connected planar graphs, the isomorphism type of the embedded dual graph determines the integral equivalence class of the Laplacian quadratic form. The source motivates it by computer experiments; no resolution is supplied here.
rows.source_name: An Huang, Shing-Tung Yau and Mei-Heng Yueh, “Graph invariants from ideas in physics and number theory”, arXiv:1409.5853 (2015).
